name: myself
description: Myself — 开源个人博客引擎（Vue 3 + Go + SQLite）

scripts.dev: concurrently -n client,server -c cyan,magenta "pnpm -C client dev" "go -C server run -tags nodynamic ./cmd/myself-server"
scripts.build: pnpm -C client build && go -C server build -tags nodynamic -o bin/myself-server ./cmd/myself-server
